packageRules.description: One weekly MR for all minor and patch updates
Major updates stay separate and are reviewed one by one

OpenSpec 1.14.1/1.14.3/1.15.0 promote >500-character requirements to WARNING: unchanged main strict spec:check fails (1.14.1 132/253 on 2026-10-13; 1.14.3 143/313 on 2026-10-18; 1.15.0 143/314 on 2026-10-25 -- 'Requirement text is very long (>500 characters)', now also reported in change deltas, same INFO->WARNING cause); retain 1.14.0 until the long requirements are split (TASK-513, wr-deploy dependency rehearsal)

pg_dump/pg_restore 18.6 and 17.11 emit transaction_timeout unsupported by the retained PostgreSQL 15 target; 16.15 passes the real backup/restore roundtrip (isolated synthetic proof 2026-10-09, TASK-359)

Existing PostgreSQL 15 data requires its storage major and Bookworm glibc collation 2.36; Trixie provides 2.41 and needs dependent indexes rebuilt before version refresh. Retain latest compatible PG15 Bookworm only for local/Helm volumes (TASK-359, 2026-10-09)

2026-10-13 actual node-saml5.1 parseDomFromString rejects xmldom0.9.12: errorHandler object is no longer supported; identical XML passes before/after on latest compatible0.8.15. Retain <0.9 globally; samlify2.15.1's declared ^0.9.12 edge is pinned by the scoped pnpm override samlify>@xmldom/xmldom (TASK-513 G3b) and is not an automatic update candidate.

2026-10-13 actual minimatch3.1.5 braceExpand({a,b}) rejects brace-expansion5.0.12: expand is not a function; unchanged case passes before/after on latest compatible1.1.21. Keep <2 only on legacy edges.

TASK-513/703: typescript-eslint 8.72.0 (latest, pin lifted) peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so hold the TypeScript 7 line (<7) until a typescript-eslint release widens that peer range. The workspace pin resolves through the @typescript/typescript6 alias (6.0.2), which only publishes 6.x, so today the rule is insurance against changing the alias.

TASK-503/513 compatibility: Sentry 11.7.0 stalls Next 16.4 webpack standalone final tracing. Oct14 campaign bisect (actual control Oct15 00:18 MSK) changes only Sentry to11.6.0 and passes build in67.48s. Evidence: ~/work/handoffs/task-503/main-integration/resume-20261014/sentry-bisect/CONTROL-PASS-READBACK.json. Recheck later releases.

2026-10-26 re-reviewed bullmq 6.4.2: terminal-job-removal still reproduces the compiled removeJob-2.js byte-for-byte (sha256 f2acb16fda20ccac200abd5289a8910e48870d454c1577b19bd375ab809bb4b6, name removeJob keys 2), and the Node Redis path only gained a CLIENT INFO helper (6.4.0 adds opt-in realtime relay messaging; 6.4.1/6.4.2 are dependency security patches). The new optional relay peers pg/redis/bullmq-otel pull no production dependency into the lock. Re-review that script before accepting the next bump (TASK-513).
